products.name: Samsung Gauss
products.note: On-device LLM; Galaxy AI; personal data processing; Korean vendor; local processing

profile_text.body:
Samsung is a global consumer electronics and home appliance manufacturer whose own site presents it as a broad technology company spanning smartphones, tablets, laptops, televisions, and smart appliances.

On the AI side, Samsung offers Galaxy AI, a suite of artificial intelligence features built into its Galaxy device lineup. The company's tracked AI product is Samsung Gauss, an on-device large language model designed to process personal data locally on the device rather than sending it to external servers. Samsung describes Galaxy AI's basic features as free, noting that future releases may include enhanced features or new services offered on a paid basis, and that different terms may apply for AI features provided by third parties. A Samsung Account login may be required to use certain AI features.

The held facts record no litigation or MCP server presence associated with Samsung at this time.
